page_title: SAS 2-1 CAG | Sassuolo v Cagliari 04/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' Sebastian Walukiewicz (Sassuolo) makes a rough challenge and Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle for a foul.
90+3' My grandmother could have scored that! Adam Obert (Cagliari) blazed the ball just over the bar from close range! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sassuolo.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' Cagliari take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) comes onto the pitch for Michel Adopo.
89' Fabio Pisacane decides to make a substitution. Sebastiano Esposito will be replaced by Paul Mendy (Cagliari).
86' 7:10 – the total goal attempt statistics.

84' Woyo Coulibaly (Sassuolo) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Daniele Chiffi with no other option than to blow for a foul.
83' That will be all from Jose Pedro who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Semih Kilicsoy (Cagliari).
82' Fabio Grosso has decided to substitute Andrea Pinamonti and he is replaced by M'Bala Nzola (Sassuolo).
81' Cagliari are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
79' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
78' 2 - 1 Goal! Darryl Bakola slips a clever pass through to Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo), who moves inside the box and sends a measured shot beyond the keeper and into the bottom left corner. 2:1.
77' The percentage of ball possession is – 54:46.
75' Fabio Pisacane has decided to make a change. Ibrahim Sulemana (Cagliari) replaces Gianluca Gaetano.
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Michael Folorunsho departs the field of play to be replaced by Gennaro Borrelli (Cagliari).
73' The Cagliari players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
70' Celebrations are cut short for Sassuolo as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
70' The Sassuolo players joy may have been justified, because referee Daniele Chiffi is going use VAR to determine whether it was offside.
70' A goal, which was scored by Luca Lipani (Sassuolo), was disallowed due to offside.
69' Fabio Grosso has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Darryl Bakola (Sassuolo) replacing Armand Lauriente.
69' Substitution. Luca Lipani (Sassuolo) on for Ismael Kone.

66' What a chance that is! Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross, but he sends his header just over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sassuolo.
64' Cagliari seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
61' Woyo Coulibaly (Sassuolo) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
59' Ismael Kone (Sassuolo) hits a dipping shot from the edge of the box that's well off target and flies miles wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
58' Substitution. Woyo Coulibaly (Sassuolo) has come on for Filippo Romagna.
58' Here is a change. Cristian Volpato is going off and Fabio Grosso gives the last tactical orders to Nemanja Matic (Sassuolo).

58' Michael Folorunsho (Cagliari) turns on the edge of the box and immediately fires in a shot at goal, but the keeper can relax as it spins well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Sassuolo will have a goal kick.
56' A defence splitting pass into the box is almost received by Marco Palestra (Cagliari), but Arijanet Muric is quick enough and comes off his line to intercept the pass.

53' Sebastian Walukiewicz (Sassuolo) cracks a shot goalwards from the edge of the box, but his radar is off and it sails well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.

50' 1 - 1 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Ulisses Garcia (Sassuolo) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a great shot into the bottom right corner. His attempt was beyond the reach of Elia Caprile, so the score changes to 1:1.
50' Sassuolo have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

49' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) elects to shoot from the edge of the box instead of sending the free kick into the box, but the defensive wall manages to block the shot. Wasted opportunity! The ball goes out of play and Sassuolo have been awarded a corner kick.
48' Juan Rodriguez (Cagliari) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. Sassuolo win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
46' Referee Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+3' Sassuolo will look to benefit from a promising free kick near the touchline.
45+1' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
45+1' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Sassuolo.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.

43' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) takes the free kick and unleashes a strong shot from mid-range. Unfortunately for him, the ball curls inches over the crossbar. What a squandered chance! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
43' Dangerous play by Yerry Mina (Cagliari). Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle for a foul. Sassuolo are awarded the free kick.
42' Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) latches onto the ball after a scramble in the box, but his placed effort towards the top of the net is far too weak and Arijanet Muric makes a simple save.
40' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Sassuolo.
38' Sebastian Walukiewicz (Sassuolo) is forced to stop his forward run after being caught in an offside position by the linesman.
35' Ulisses Garcia (Sassuolo) was too forceful with his tackle and Daniele Chiffi interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
33' Michael Folorunsho (Cagliari) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.
33' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Cagliari, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
30' 0 - 1 Goal! Arijanet Muric gets a hand on the penalty from Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari), but can't stop it from flying into the bottom left corner.
30' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) is going to take the penalty!
28' It’s a PENALTY to Cagliari after the VAR review!
28' There's a break in play and referee Daniele Chiffi must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Cagliari using VAR. This could be interesting!
26' That looked a certain handball by Jay Idzes (Sassuolo) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
26' Michael Folorunsho (Cagliari) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.

24' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Cagliari are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
22' Yerry Mina (Cagliari) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked.
21' Cagliari can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
21' Michael Folorunsho (Cagliari) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. Now Cagliari have a corner.

20' Cagliari are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
17' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top of net only for Elia Caprile to dive and make a save.

17' It looks like Juan Rodriguez (Cagliari) saw red with that tackle. Daniele Chiffi won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Sassuolo, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
15' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) makes a run into the box and gets on the end of a cross, but his well-taken shot crashes into a defender and is cleared away.
12' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
10' Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
9' Ulisses Garcia (Sassuolo) is penalised for a foul. Daniele Chiffi had a clear view and blows his whistle.
8' The Sassuolo players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.

5' The defence just can't clear the ball and a rebound eventually falls to Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) deep inside the box, but his well-hit shot flies just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.

3' Michel Adopo (Cagliari) clutches his head in despair after he blew a huge opportunity! He received the ball from the free kick, took a good first touch and unleashed a projectile from close range to the middle of the goal, but Arijanet Muric makes a nice save.
3' Cagliari are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
2' Looks like Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Cagliari will kick-off.
Daniele Chiffi will supervise the game today.
